Meat, poultry, and meat products: Nutritional value


Veal
Although representing a smaller proportion of overall meat consumption, veal still provides a nutrient proﬁle that is very beneﬁcial.
As with all meat sources, veal provides high-quality protein in a product that may be slightly leaner (in terms of fat) than other red
meat sources. Compared to other meat sources, veal would have a lower iron content.
